rule.why: Recommended decoupling between VDD and GND, ceramic, placed right at the pins.

rule.source: MCP9808 datasheet, 3.1 Serial Data Line, p.11
rule.why: SDA is open-drain: the chip can only pull it low, so a resistor has to pull it high.

rule.source: MCP9808 datasheet, 4.0 Serial Communication; I2C bus is open-drain
rule.why: Same as SDA. 4.7k is a common choice for a short 3.3V bus.
Address is 0011 A2 A1 A0. The spec wants 0x18, so A2, A1 and A0 are all 0.
Open-drain alert output. This board doesn't use it, so it stays unconnected.
